model_missed_context.description: Relevant context changes the judgment made from the cited passage.

model_overweighted_quote.description: A quotation was treated as the article's own position.

label_too_strong.description: The direction is plausible but the intensity is overstated.

label_too_weak.description: The direction is plausible but the intensity is understated.

neutral_vs_not_applicable.description: The axis is absent rather than substantively neutral, or vice versa.

insufficient_public_context.description: The public excerpt and available source are insufficient to judge.

wrong_party_identity.description: The named party was mapped to the wrong canonical party.

party_missing.description: A meaningfully treated party is absent from the model set.

party_not_meaningful.description: The model party is only incidental and should not be scored.

tone_misread.description: The party treatment has the wrong favorable, unfavorable, neutral or mixed tone.

other.description: A documented reason not covered by the registry.
